title: Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: Grilled beef skewers served with a spicy twist, inspired by the flavors of Argentina.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together lime zest, garlic, and chimichurri sauce.
3. Add the beef cubes, red onion, and red bell pepper to the bowl. Toss to coat with the marinade.
4. Thread the beef and vegetables onto skewers, leaving space between each piece.
5. Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the beef reaches your desired level of doneness.
7. Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
8. Serve hot, garnished with additional lime wedges and chimichurri sauce if desired.
9. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
10. Enjoy your delicious Argentinian Beef Skewers!
